concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-004 (Support‑ticket volume) is defined in the specification but no task in tasks.md implements its measurement or validation, resulting in a dropped acceptance criterion.

The Constitution (Principle I) mandates a reproducibility utility that pins random seeds in `code/`. No task creates or verifies such a seed‑pinning module (e.g., `utils/seeds.py`), violating the non‑negotiable reproducibility requirement.
